name: tilt-parallax-button
title: Tilt Parallax Button
description: A primary button calculating 3D perspective rotation and specular rim lighting under mouse hover angle.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Luxury
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Compact
Shape: Pill
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Grotesk
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Button Tilt Perspective: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
